tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Sales / C2C Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in contributing my expertise to your upcoming sales and consulting initiatives. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical and consultative capabilities to client delivery.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Enterprise Delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring for major global enterprises.

bullets.label: API Integrations & Headless Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Acted as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating requirements into functional specifications and robust SAP solutions.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated effectively with international technical teams to resolve integration bottlenecks and ensure smooth release cycles.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026, and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise and techno-functional consulting background to your organization to drive successful client delivery and high-impact e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce experience, strong technical delivery, and techno-functional consulting skills to support your upcoming projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell, specializing in Java, Spring, and API integrations. Based in Germany with a valid work permit, I am available from 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Consultant Role – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Consultant position. With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, Spring, and integration capabilities.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available from 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
